scripts.tools:ci: npm ci --prefix tools/openapi-generator --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix tools/engine-dto-generator --ignore-scripts
scripts.generate: tsc -b packages/protocol --pretty false && node scripts/generate-runtime-openapi.mjs && biome format --write protocol/runtime-v1.openapi.json && npm run generate --prefix tools/openapi-generator && npm run generate --prefix tools/engine-dto-generator
scripts.security: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix tools/openapi-generator --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix tools/engine-dto-generator --audit-level=high
scripts.engine:check: npm run unity:check && npm run godot:check && npm run unreal:check
scripts.gate: npm run tools:ci && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run generate:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run example:local && npm run benchmark:media:check && npm run package:check && npm run security && npm run unreal:structure:check && npm run public-tree
scripts.full:gate: npm run gate && npm run engine:check
